text: 6 steps for augmented reality game development
heading: Our Proven Augmented Reality Game Development Process is Smart, Lean, & Agile
text2: Our augmented reality game development process runs from understanding your idea to launching and supporting the finished product. Each step has a clear outcome so you always know what is happening and what comes next.

items.title: Concept Workshop
items.text: We turn your idea for Augmented Reality Game Development into a clear concept, target audience, core loop and scope.

items.title: Game Design Document
items.text: Mechanics, levels, progression, economy and monetization are documented before production starts.

items.title: Playable Prototype
items.text: A quick prototype lets you feel the core gameplay and refine it while changes are cheap.

items.title: Launch and Live Ops
items.text: We publish the game, track player data and ship updates and new content.

items.title: Testing and Balancing
items.text: We playtest on real devices, fix bugs and balance difficulty and rewards.

items.title: Art and Production
items.text: Artists and developers build characters, environments, UI, animations and gameplay systems in sprints.
